warp FireTemple FireTemple adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 1200               # the five bots follow A into FireTemple
mark r01-entrada        # the first room
place 0.00 104.60 12.20
wait 300
mark caida              # A falls here: bots 3 and 4 come and hold A beside it
